The upgrade has been rescheduled: the production cutover of the main database from Postgres 13 to Postgres 17 is now **Saturday, December 5, 2026, 02:00–05:00 UTC** [2]. This was approved by Maya Cohen [2] and replaces the earlier plan of Saturday Nov 21, 02:00–05:00 UTC announced in #eng-announce [3], which was postponed after the Nov 12 incident and ahead of the Fernhill go-live on Dec 1 [5].

Key dates for your customer notice and support macro, per ticket KES-398 (which is now the reference for the window, since the Notion runbook isn't updated yet) [2]:
- Customer notice (status page + in-app banner): **Saturday, Nov 28**
- Migration/schema freeze: from **Thursday, Dec 3**
- Staging rehearsal: **Friday, Nov 27**
- Maintenance window: **Saturday, Dec 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC**
